access: read-only sqlite3 immutable URI; no fixture writes, no native launch
cause: Startup deliberately skips reading historical report bodies. Before this fix, research_result() required non-empty output, so the correctly persisted run 19 was treated as having no result: presentation reported no final report and step completion counted 0/1. The database was not missing or stale.
fix: Store records which runs have a known durable body without loading it.
research_result() still returns None for an unloaded body, so prompts, exports and validation cannot consume empty content.
A separate pending-body predicate drives presentation/completed-step counts only.
Opening a period requests its final body and all lazy step bodies, bounded per poll; loaded/loading targets do not consume the batch budget.
Absent or failed body reads show an explicit unavailable notice instead of perpetual loading or a current-report claim.
Lazy markers are cleared on hydration, run removal and incarnation reset; a later non-Simulated failed/retry attempt invalidates an older lazy body.
